title: Setting
description: board page to board-host: the user changed one presentation key on the board, which the session process writes into the user file (AD-14, FR-35). Only theme, density and contextPlacement, each with a value the configuration schema allows; board-host refuses anything else with reason message, and nothing is written. ask-core checks the key again before it writes (settings-languages, design decision 6).

value.description: The key's new value, checked against that key's values below.
